auth.loginDescription: Sign in with your email address and password.
auth.passwordRules: Use at least 12 characters. Repeated characters, sequences, keyboard rows, and your email address or the site name are not allowed.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.description: Confirm your identity again before this operation.
reauth.ssoDescription: Confirm with a passkey, or by signing in to the identity provider again. If you use the identity provider, repeat the action after you return.
reauth.ssoAdminDescription: Administrators who signed in with single sign-on confirm with a passkey.
reauth.withIdp: Sign in to the identity provider again

reset.requestDescription: We will email a reset link to your registered address.
reset.requestSent: If the address is registered, we sent an email. Use the link in it to reset your password.
reset.passwordDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
reset.mfaDescription: This removes multi-factor authentication. Then sign in with your password and set it up again.
reset.mfaDone: Multi-factor authentication was removed. Sign in and set it up again.

invite.title: Workspace invitation
invite.asNew: Choose a password to create your account.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.empty: You don't belong to any workspace.
workspaces.newDescription: Enter the template name (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens). Leave it empty for default.
workspaces.name: Name

security.title: Account security
security.requiredDescription: This CMS requires multi-factor authentication for everyone. Other operations are unavailable until you set it up.
security.totpDescription: Use a 6-digit code from an authenticator app each time you sign in.
security.totpManual: Enter this key in your authenticator app.
security.totpOpenApp: Open in an authenticator app on this device
security.passkeysDescription: Sign in with your device's biometrics or a security key.
security.recoveryDescription: Generating new codes makes the old ones stop working.
security.recoveryCodesDescription: Shown only on this screen. Store them somewhere safe. Each can be used once.
security.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. You were signed out on other devices.
security.passkeyRequiredDescription: Administrators who sign in with single sign-on must register a passkey for this CMS before using admin operations.
security.identitiesDescription: Link your {name} account to sign in with it.

errors.generic: The request could not be completed ({status}).
errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.invalid_passkey: The passkey could not be verified.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
errors.csrf_failed: This screen cannot perform the operation. Please sign in again.
errors.weak_password: This password cannot be used. Check the rules.
errors.breached_password: This password appears in known data breaches. Choose a different one.
errors.invalid_token: The link is invalid or has expired.
errors.reauth_failed: Your identity could not be confirmed.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this operation.
errors.account_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in, then accept the invitation.
errors.already_member: You already belong to this workspace.
errors.passkeys_unavailable: Passkeys are not available on this server.
errors.mfa_already_enabled: The authenticator app is already set up.
errors.mfa_not_enabled: Multi-factor authentication is not set up.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.revision_conflict: Someone else saved this draft first. Reload it and apply your changes again.
errors.slug_taken: Another entry in this locale already uses this slug.
errors.invalid_entry: Part of the entry is not accepted.
errors.alt_text_missing: Some images have no alternative text, so the entry cannot be published.
errors.url_taken: Another published entry already uses this URL.
errors.nothing_to_correct: An entry that has never been published cannot be published as a correction.
errors.url_function_failed: The public URL could not be made because of a problem in the template's URL function. Ask the template developer to fix it.
errors.publish_rejected_by_hook: The template's beforePublish hook stopped publishing.
errors.hook_failed: The template's beforePublish hook has a problem, so the entry could not be published. Ask the template developer to fix it.
errors.schema_migration_pending: Editing and publishing are paused while the schema migration is pending.
errors.schema_not_deployed: No schema has been applied to this workspace yet.
errors.unsupported_media_type: This image format is not supported.
errors.invalid_image: The image could not be read.
errors.image_too_large: The image has too many pixels.
errors.media_quota_exceeded: This would exceed the workspace's media storage limit.
errors.image_processing_timeout: Processing the image took too long.
errors.version_is_published: The published version cannot be erased.
errors.media_in_use: This media is used by entries.
errors.last_admin: A workspace must keep at least one administrator.
errors.smtp_required: Email (SMTP) is not configured, so only server administrators can invite.
errors.too_many_webhooks: No more webhooks can be added.
errors.server_admin_target: Server administrators can only be recovered with the server CLI.
errors.outside_scope: This person also belongs to a workspace you do not administer. Ask a server administrator.
errors.deploy_scope_forbidden: Only server administrators can issue tokens with the deploy scope.
errors.deploy_scope_exclusive: The deploy scope cannot be combined with other scopes.
errors.last_sign_in_method: Set a password first. This is your only way to sign in.
errors.oidc_not_configured: Single sign-on is not configured on this server.
errors.oidc_unavailable: Single sign-on is unavailable because outbound HTTP is not configured correctly.
errors.idp_unreachable: The identity provider could not be reached or is not configured correctly.
errors.reauth_method_not_allowed: This method cannot be used to confirm your identity.
errors.budget_exceeds_ceiling: This exceeds the limit set by the server administrator.
errors.answer_test_rate_limited: Too many answer tests in a row. Wait about a minute and try again.

editor.readonlyUnknown: This body contains elements the admin editor cannot handle ({names}), so it cannot be edited here.

link.title: Link
link.description: Enter the URL to link to. Leave it empty to remove the link.
link.invalid: Enter an https, http, mailto or tel URL, or a path starting with / or #.

image.missing: Add alternative text or mark the image as decorative. It cannot be published otherwise.

embed.title: Embed
embed.description: Enter an https URL from an allowed provider ({providers}).
embed.label: Embed URL
embed.notAllowed: This is not an https URL from an allowed provider ({providers}).

entries.newDescription: Choose the content type and locale. Translations are created from the original entry.
entries.noSchema: No schema has been applied to this workspace yet.
entries.migrationPending: Editing and publishing are paused while the schema migration is pending. They resume once it completes.
entries.title: Title
entries.slugHint: Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Used in the public URL.

save.locked: Cannot save: someone else is editing

entries.conflict: Someone else saved this draft first. Autosave is stopped so their changes are not overwritten. Reloading discards your unsaved changes, so copy anything you need first.
entries.hookFailure: The template's beforeSave hook failed, so the draft was saved without its changes. Let the template developer know.
entries.leaveUnsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?
entries.unpublishDescription: Removes the entry from the public site. The draft and version history are kept.
entries.deleteDescription: Deletes the entry and stops publishing it. This cannot be undone from the admin.

publish.title: Review before publishing
publish.correctionDescription: Publishes this as a correction of an error. The fact of the correction and the affected sections are made public. The previous text and the diff are not.
publish.notSaved: There are unsaved changes, so this cannot be checked. Check the save status.
publish.missingAltHelp: Add alternative text or mark them as decorative. Entries with such images cannot be published.
publish.noUrl: Enter a slug to decide the public URL.
publish.urlChanged: The URL changes (was: {from}). The old URL is kept in the URL history.
publish.erased: The previous version's body was erased, so it cannot be compared.
publish.noChanges: No sections of the body changed.
publish.correctionHint: Numbers, dates or links changed in these sections. Is this a correction of an error? If so, use "Publish as correction": {sections}

translations.noSource: No source entry (this is the source, or there is none).
translations.members: Entries in the same translation group
translations.createHelp: Copies this entry's draft into a new entry in another locale.
translations.setSourceDescription: The {locale} entry becomes the source. The reflected version becomes its current version.

settings.note: Changes to these switches are announced by webhook. Materials for external AI and the AI-training opt-out are applied by the site integration. "Use for the chatbot" applies from the next answer.
settings.showDefaults: Show settings left at their defaults ({n})
settings.hideDefaults: Hide settings left at their defaults

useForChatbot.label: Use for the chatbot
useForChatbot.help: Use this entry as a source for the visitor chatbot's answers.

includeInAiMaterials.label: Include in materials for external AI
includeInAiMaterials.help: Include this entry in materials for external AI, such as the Markdown version and llms.txt.

optOutOfAiTraining.label: Opt out of AI training
optOutOfAiTraining.help: Mark the external materials so that they are not used for AI training.

settings.needPermission: To change these switches, ask an administrator for the policy switches permission.

urlHistory.empty: The public URL has not changed.

versions.empty: No version has been published yet.
versions.unknownNodes: This version contains elements the admin editor cannot display ({names}). Showing the text only.
versions.eraseDescription: Keeps the version's number, dates and other records, and removes only the body from every API. This cannot be undone.
versions.eraseCurrent: The published version cannot be erased. Publish a fixed version (as a correction), or unpublish the entry, and then erase it.
versions.eraseBackups: The erased content remains in database backups taken before the erasure.
versions.eraseMedia: Media that can be deleted with it
versions.eraseMediaHelp: Media used in this version and not used by any version or draft of any entry (translations included). Anyone with the URL can see media, so they are selected by default.
versions.eraseOtherLocalesHelp: Entries in the same translation group may still contain the same content in translation. Erase it in each entry if needed.

media.title: Media
media.deleteDescription: Deletes the file. This cannot be undone.
media.inUse: This media is used by entries. Their images will no longer be shown. Delete it anyway?

secretOnce.warning: This value is shown only now. Once closed it cannot be shown again, so store it somewhere safe.

members.removeDescription: Removes {email} from this workspace. Their entries and versions are kept.
members.passwordResetSent: A password reset email was sent to {email}.
members.mfaResetSent: An MFA reset email was sent to {email}.
members.passwordResetLink: Password reset link for {email} (give it to them)
members.mfaResetLink: MFA reset link for {email} (give it to them)
members.heavyHelp: Permissions granted to the person on top of their role. Granting and revoking are recorded in the audit log.

invitations.sent: An invitation email was sent to {email}.
invitations.link: Invitation link for {email} (give it to them)
invitations.revokeDescription: Revokes the invitation to {email}. The link sent will no longer work.

apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.revokeDescription: Revokes "{name}". Sites using this key will no longer be able to read the delivery API.
apiKeys.answerNote: Each call to the answer API costs LLM usage (within this workspace's visitor answer budget). Keep this key on the server that relays visitors' questions, and never send it to browsers.

webhooks.help: Only https URLs that resolve to public addresses can be added. Entry events such as publishing and updates are sent with a signature.
webhooks.rotated: New signing secret for {url} (the old one also signs until {until})

audit.note: Only the kind of operation, who did it, the targets and the time are recorded (no content).

auth.user_enabled: User allowed to sign in again

audit_export.removed: Audit log destination removed from the config

assist.settings_changed: Changed the editor AI assist setting

audit.downloadHelp: Downloads the filtered records, newest first, up to 10,000, as JSON Lines (.jsonl).

server.title: Server administration
server.cliOnly: Server administrators are recovered with the server CLI

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.help: End any session you do not recognize, and consider changing your password.

tokens.help: Tokens for the CLI (import, deploy and so on). A token can only do what both its scopes and your current role allow. The deploy scope cannot be combined with other scopes and lasts up to 30 days.
tokens.revokeDescription: Revokes "{name}". CLIs using this token will stop working.
tokens.noMemberships: You are not a member of any workspace. A token used only for deploying can be issued without choosing a workspace.

profile.help: The name other members see when choosing a reviewer and in review history. 1 to 50 characters; you can change it at any time.
profile.required: Choose a display name before using the admin UI.

errors.generic: Single sign-on could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.invalid_state: The sign-in could not be matched or has expired. Please start again.
errors.cancelled: The sign-in was cancelled at the identity provider.
errors.invalid_request: The identity provider's response was not valid.
errors.idp_error: The identity provider could not be reached or is not configured correctly. Contact your administrator.
errors.invalid_id_token: The information from the identity provider could not be verified.
errors.not_registered: This account cannot be used here yet. Accept an invitation, or sign in and link the account first.
errors.email_not_verified: Your email address is not verified at the identity provider.
errors.email_mismatch: The identity provider's email address does not match the invitation.
errors.account_exists: An account with this email address already exists. Sign in, accept the invitation, and then link the account.
errors.already_linked: This identity provider account is already linked to someone else, or you already linked an account from this provider.
errors.invitation_invalid: The invitation is invalid or has expired.
errors.identity_mismatch: The identity provider account does not match the signed-in account.
errors.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.oidc_not_configured: Single sign-on is not configured on this server.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server.

corrections.noteHelp: Tell readers what was corrected (optional). You can rewrite it later in the Versions tab. Without a note, the workspace fallback text is shown.
corrections.editNoteDescription: Only the new note appears in the delivery API and the corrections feed. The edit history stays in the admin UI. Clear it to go back to no note.

freshness.verifyHelp: Record that the content is still accurate. The last verified date becomes today and the review deadline moves. No version is created. The memo stays in the admin UI.
freshness.notPublished: Only entries that have been published can be verified.

correctionTemplates.help: Per locale, set the notes editors can pick when publishing a correction, and the text shown for corrections without a note. A picked note is copied at that moment, so changing it here does not change past notes.
correctionTemplates.fallback: Text when there is no note

viewQuestionLog.label: View the question log
viewQuestionLog.help: See the questions visitors asked the chatbot. No role has this by default.

manageLlm.label: LLM connection and budget
manageLlm.help: Change the LLM endpoints and the token budgets.

policySwitches.label: Policy switches
policySwitches.help: Change whether an entry is included in materials for external AI, opts out of AI training, or is used for the chatbot.

corrections.label: Corrections and verification
corrections.help: Publish a published entry as a correction, write correction notes, and record verification. Does not allow ordinary publishing.

takeOverEditing.label: Take over editing
takeOverEditing.help: Take over editing an entry someone else is editing.

review.help: People who cannot publish ask someone who can by requesting a review. People who can publish may publish without a request. Publishing closes the open request.
review.rejectHelp: Say what should be fixed. The comment stays in this entry's review history.

schedule.title: Schedule publication
schedule.description: Freeze the current draft as the scheduled version and publish it at the chosen time. Editing the draft afterwards does not change the scheduled version.
schedule.atHelp: Time in {zone}. Publication happens within seconds after that time (up to a year ahead).
schedule.draftChanged: The draft has changes that are not in the scheduled version. Schedule again to include them.
schedule.retrying: Waiting to publish: {reason}. Next attempt at {at}.
schedule.failed: The publication scheduled for {at} failed after 24 hours of retrying ({reason}).
schedule.cancelledByCorrection: The publication scheduled for {at} was cancelled because a correction was published.

errors.url_taken: Another published entry uses the same URL

editLock.held: {who} is editing this entry (since {at}). It is read-only for you.
editLock.sameUser: You are editing this entry in another window. Take over to edit here.
editLock.lost: {who} took over editing. This entry is now read-only for you.
editLock.unsavedKept: Your unsaved input is still on the screen. Copy it if you need it.
editLock.lostSameUser: You started editing this entry in another window, so this one is now read-only.

workspaceSettings.takeOverHelp: Choose who can take over an entry someone else is editing. Take-overs are recorded in the audit log.
workspaceSettings.permission: Only people with the take over editing permission (administrators and editors by default, plus individual grants)
workspaceSettings.previewHelp: Sites where entry previews open. A preview opens only when the origin of the entry's public URL is listed here. The live preview frame and messages from the site are also limited to these sites.
workspaceSettings.previewOriginsHelp: One per line, like https://example.com (up to 10; http only for localhost).
workspaceSettings.previewPathHelp: The official Nuxt module uses /_yomi/preview by default. Match the site's yomi.preview.route.

sourceUpdate.updated: The source entry has been updated.
sourceUpdate.corrected: The source entry has been corrected.
sourceUpdate.upToDate: All source updates have been reflected.
sourceUpdate.publishUpdated: The source entry has updates you have not reviewed. You can still publish, but review the changes and mark them as reflected.
sourceUpdate.publishCorrected: The source entry has corrections you have not reviewed. You can still publish, but review the changes and mark them as reflected.

sourceDiff.title: Source changes
sourceDiff.description: Changes to the source entry since the version last marked as reflected. Nothing is applied automatically.
sourceDiff.changedFields: Changed fields other than the body

unavailable.no_source: This entry has no source entry.
unavailable.no_version: The source entry has not been published yet.
unavailable.not_reflected: No reflected version is recorded, so changes cannot be shown.
unavailable.erased: The body of a compared version has been erased, so changes cannot be shown.

todo.help: Things you can act on, most urgent first. Opening one takes you to the matching tab of the entry.

notice.expired: This entry is past its review date. Check the content and record it as verified.

todo.budgetExhausted: The embedding budget is used up. Search data for new entries is not created until the limit is raised or the next period (UTC) starts.
todo.embeddingModelMissing: The embedding model this workspace uses is no longer in the server config. Vector search is off until the switch is started.
todo.answerBudgetExhausted: The visitor answer budget is used up. The answer API returns a budget error until the limit is raised or the next period (UTC) starts.
todo.assistBudgetExhausted: The editor assist budget is used up. AI assist stops until you raise the limit or the next period (UTC) starts. Publishing works as usual.

preview.noUrl: The preview cannot open because the entry has no public URL yet. Enter a slug.
preview.notAllowed: The site of this entry's public URL is not in the list of sites allowed to show previews.
preview.cookieNote: If the preview does not update or shows the published content, your browser is blocking cookies in this frame. Use "Open in a new tab".

auditSinks.title: Destinations (webhooks)
auditSinks.help: Sends this workspace's audit log as JSON Lines. Only records after the destination is added are sent, signed like entry webhooks. A destination that fails for 7 days in a row is stopped.
auditSinks.created: Added {url}. The signing secret is shown only now.
auditSinks.stoppedAt: Stopped at {at}. Resume to continue from where it stopped.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.serverHelp: Instance-wide events (spikes in failed sign-ins, new server administrators, emergency operations, and so on) from the last 7 days. Marking as read removes it only from your list; the record stays in the audit log.

budget.visitorUsage: Embeddings of visitors' search terms and questions are counted separately under the same limits. When they run out, only keyword search works. This month: {month} tokens. Today: {day} tokens.
budget.help: The budget for creating embeddings from published entries, used for search and related entries. It is counted in tokens, and the LLM is called only within the budget. When it runs out, creation stops and the existing embeddings keep working.
budget.egressNote: The contents of searchable fields are sent to the LLM endpoint configured on the server to create embeddings.
budget.noLlm: No LLM endpoint is configured, so embeddings are not created ([llm] in the server config file).
budget.exhaustedHelp: Embedding creation has been paused since {at} because the budget is not enough. It resumes when the limit is raised or the next period (UTC) starts.
budget.cost: Estimated cost this month: {cost} ({price} per million tokens, the price set on the server)
budget.utc: Months and days follow the UTC calendar.
budget.limitsHelp: You can set limits within the ceiling set by the server administrator. With "No limit", the ceiling applies as is.
budget.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
budget.ceilingHelp: The highest limits this workspace can set. LLM charges go to the instance's key. With "Default", the default in the server config file applies (0 if none).
budget.answerHelp: The budget for answering visitors' questions through the answer API. Input (the question and entry fragments) and output (the answer) are counted separately in tokens. The LLM is called only within the budget; otherwise the API returns a budget error.
budget.answerEgressNote: Visitors' questions (with email addresses, phone numbers and similar patterns masked) and the entry fragments used as grounds are sent to the LLM endpoint configured on the server. Free-form personal details such as names or addresses are not masked.
budget.noChat: Answers are not available because no chat model is configured (chat_model under [llm] in the server configuration file).
budget.answerExhaustedHelp: Since {at}, answers have been refused because the budget is used up. They resume when the limit is raised or the next period (UTC) starts.
budget.assistHelp: Used for conflict detection, review hints and article outlines. Input and output are counted separately, in tokens. When it runs out, only the assist stops; publishing is never blocked.
budget.assistExhaustedHelp: Since {at}, assist has been stopped because the budget is used up. It resumes when you raise the limit or the next period (UTC) starts. Publishing still works.

embeddingSwitch.title: Embedding model
embeddingSwitch.noLlm: No LLM endpoint ([llm]) is configured, so no embeddings are created.
embeddingSwitch.howToSet: The model to switch to can only be set in the config file. Add the following and restart the server; then you can review the estimate and start here.
embeddingSwitch.estimateHelp: Tokens are over-estimated at 1 character = 1 token. The cost uses the price in the config. Embeddings are created within each workspace's embedding budget and pause when it runs out. Search keeps using the current model until the switch completes.
embeddingSwitch.running: Switching. Each workspace switches as soon as all of its embeddings are ready.
embeddingSwitch.confirmDescription: {chunks} chunks, {tokens} tokens (estimate), cost {cost}. Embeddings are created within each workspace's budget.

related.note: Related entries are chosen automatically by how close the whole entries are in content. Pinned entries come first, in the pinned order. Excluded entries are never shown. Pins and exclusions point to translation groups and are returned as the entry in this entry's locale. Changes take effect immediately.
related.needPermission: Only people who can publish (editors and admins) can change pins and exclusions.
related.none: None yet (they are computed once the search data is ready).
related.recomputeHelp: Related entries are recomputed every day at a set time. You can recompute them now, for example after changing the template. It uses stored data, so it has no LLM cost.
related.queued: Started. The results appear in a few minutes.
related.alreadyQueued: A recomputation is already waiting or running.

chatbot.title: Chatbot answers
chatbot.help: Choose how answers to visitors' questions sound, and what to say when there is no answer. Citations are always checked, whatever you choose.
chatbot.lengthHelp: The length is only an instruction to the language model. The maximum answer length does not change.
chatbot.freePromptWarning: Depending on the instructions, answers may become less accurate. The free-form prompt only sets the tone; it cannot change the CMS rules such as citation checks.
chatbot.freePromptOff: The text is saved even when it is not used (it is not sent to the language model).
chatbot.phrasesHelp: Shown to visitors when no entry answers the question or the answer fails the checks. Set one per content locale (up to {max} characters).
chatbot.egressNote: Visitors' questions (masked) are sent to the external language model provider.
chatbot.refusalHelp: Questions containing these words or numbers are not answered (error code QUESTION_REFUSED). They are not sent to the language model or embeddings, and not kept in the question log. Email addresses, phone numbers and IP addresses are always masked before sending, apart from this setting.
chatbot.refuseWords: Words to refuse (one per line, up to {max})
chatbot.refuseWordsHelp: {count} words. Matching ignores full-width/half-width and upper/lower case.
chatbot.refuseTooLong: Each word can be up to {max} characters.
chatbot.refuseCreditCard: Do not answer questions containing what looks like a credit card number
chatbot.refuseMyNumber: Do not answer questions containing what looks like a 12-digit My Number

questionLog.settingsHelp: Keeps unanswered visitor questions as "articles to write". Answered questions are only counted per day. Viewing needs the question log permission.
questionLog.privacyNote: If you keep a question log, mention it in your site's privacy policy. Fixed patterns such as email addresses, phone numbers and IP addresses are masked, but free-form details such as names and addresses are not.
questionLog.daysInvalid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
questionLog.disableDescription: The stored questions are deleted right away and cannot be restored. Daily counts are kept.
questionLog.candidatesHelp: Unanswered questions grouped by question, most frequent first (kept for {days} days). Fixed patterns in the questions are masked.
questionLog.disabled: This workspace does not keep a question log (change it in Admin > Settings).
questionLog.deleteDescription: All records of this question are deleted. This cannot be undone.

llmOverride.title: LLM settings (this workspace)
llmOverride.help: Choose the LLM for this workspace's answers and embeddings from the endpoints the server administrator allows. If you do not choose, the server settings are used.
llmOverride.allow: Allow this workspace to override the LLM settings (server administrator)
llmOverride.notAllowed: This workspace uses the server's LLM settings (overrides are possible only when the server administrator allows them).
llmOverride.noEndpoints: The server administrator has not allowed any endpoints.
llmOverride.apiKeySet: Set ({at}). Enter a key only to change it. Saved keys are never shown.
llmOverride.apiKeyRequired: An API key is required the first time. Saved keys are never shown.
llmOverride.chatModelPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the server's model
llmOverride.embeddingHelp: Changing the model rebuilds the embeddings of every entry. Saving does not switch by itself; check the estimate below and start the switch.
llmOverride.egressNote: Entry text and visitors' questions (masked) are sent to the provider of the chosen endpoint.
llmOverride.removeDescription: The saved API key is deleted and the server's LLM settings are used. If you changed the embedding model, a switch back to the server's model may be needed.

state.notStarted: The switch to {desired} has not started (searching with {active}).
state.inProgress: Building embeddings for {desired}. Search uses {active} until they are complete.
state.paused: Building embeddings for {desired} is paused because the budget is used up (searching with {active}).
state.needsMigration: The current model ({active}) is not available. A switch to {desired} is needed (vector search is off until then).

llmOverride.switchFailed: The switch was stopped (reason: {code}). Ask the server administrator to check the model's dimensions, then start again.
llmOverride.startSwitch: Check the estimate and start the switch

assist.settingsHelp: Enables conflict detection on the publish screen, review hints for overdue articles and article outlines from the question log. It runs within the editor assist budget.
assist.egressNote: When enabled, unpublished drafts are sent to the external LLM provider. For sites with confidential content, we recommend a local LLM.
assist.disabled: AI assist is disabled in this workspace.
assist.failed: The AI check could not be completed. Please try again later.
assist.budgetExhaustedMonth: This month's limit has been reached.
assist.noConflicts: No conflicts with similar articles were found.
assist.conflictsNote: This is an AI check and may miss things or be wrong. You can publish without waiting for it.
assist.staleHelp: The AI lists places in the saved draft that may be outdated (version numbers, prices, dates, external links).
assist.noHints: Nothing that looks outdated was found.
assist.outlineNote: This outline was written by AI. Check the facts when you write the article.

answerTest.title: Try an answer
answerTest.help: Ask a test question to see the fragments found and their scores, the AI's verdict and the answer. It uses the tone you are editing above, even before you save it.
answerTest.question: Question (up to {max} characters)
answerTest.note: This uses the visitor answer budget. The answer cache is not used and nothing is written to the question log. Refused words and masking apply as in production.
answerTest.masked: Question sent to the LLM (after masking)
answerTest.noFragments: No fragments were found, so the LLM was not called and the answer is "no information".
answerTest.scores: Rank score {score} / vector similarity {vector} / keyword score {keyword}
answerTest.noDeclaration: The declaration could not be read, so the answer is "no information".
answerTest.notAnswerable: It declared that it cannot answer.
answerTest.answerable: It declared that it can answer (fragments: {sources}).

errors.ANSWER_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: The visitor answer budget is used up, so no answer was made.
